services.name: Class A Motor Home Site
services.desc: Normal check-in hours are between 2pm and 8pm. Early check-in is accepted if your site is available and will be assessed and additional $10 fee. Late Check-in: We strive to keep our park quiet and peaceful at night because guests are tired and resting, which is imperative to safer traveling. It is inconsiderate for a guest to disturb the numerous other guests who arrived within the generous check-in window. Checking in late (8-10pm) is acceptable on a case-by-case basis by communication with the office attendant from the guest and will NOT be accepted after 10pm. If guest cannot arrive by 10pm, their reservation is void and the guest if considered a "no-show" reservation. Please check-out
